sources.title: ONNX Model Zoo
sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: Toto-2.0-22m — TSFM.ai
sources.snippet: Toto-2.0-22m is the lightweight production candidate in Datadog's Toto 2.0 family, sitting one rung above the 4M smoke-test checkpoint on the size ladder. At 22M parameters it is sized for lower-latency observability forecasting while retaining the full 2.0 architecture shift to alternating time/variate attention and native quantile bands.
